-Service: The service must be hit underhand and below the waist. The server serves diagonally across the net to the receiver. The service court alternates after each point, and the service side changes after a side wins a point when serving.-Let: If the shuttlecock touches the net on the serve but still lands within the correct service area, this is called a letänd the serve is replayed.### Gameplay-Service and Court Sides: The serving side must serve from the right court if they have an even number of points and from the left court if they have an odd number of points. The receiving side stands in the opposite court.-Movement: Players must move around the court to return the shuttlecock, often lunging, jumping, and diving to reach shots.-Techniques: Badminton requires a variety of shots, including serves, smashes (powerful downward shots), clears (high shots to the back of the court), and drop shots (short shots that land near the net).### Strategy-Court Positioning: Players must maintain good court positioning, ready to react to shots and move quickly.-Variation of Shots: Using a mix of fast, slow, high, and low shots can keep the opponent guessing and off-balance.-Consistency and Patience:
